name: category-bar
title: Category Bar
description: A single horizontal bar split into coloured ranges, with an optional marker and labels. It plots values like a credit score or storage usage against their bands.
use: A value needs context against labelled ranges rather than a plain progress bar.
avoid: The bar is decorative for screen readers: it exposes no meter role or readable value text.
a11y: Exposes only an aria-label and aria-valuenow with no bar role, and the tooltip is hover-only with no keyboard path. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Thin segmented bars in pink, amber, lime and green sit inside dark cards, with small Poor to Excellent labels beneath. A slim white-ringed tick marks the current value and pops a small tooltip on hover.
behaves: The marker glides to a new percentage when its value changes, and hovering it shows the exact figure in a small dark tooltip. Band colours are fixed per segment.
customise: Values, per-segment colours, an optional marker with tooltip and a labels toggle are props; heights and rounding are fixed classes.
weight: light: A few divs and one CSS position transition; no charting engine.
demo: Cards for Credit score 724, Storage used 74.2 GB and API latency 182 ms, with Poor to Excellent bands.
issues: Bar has aria-valuenow but no role, so screen readers do not treat it as a meter.
polishWhy: Crisp segmented bars with clear band labels and a neat marker tooltip.

props.name: marker
